## About
Tree Wise Men is led by president Jordy Hagen, an ISA certified arborist who has worked in the U.S., Canada and Australia. He knows the conditions the Texas treescape faces with drought and disease, and he can inventory and analyze your trees and plan for the long-term development of your treescape.
The crew includes foreman and tree climber Ernest Raddatz, tree climbers Jaime Rodriguez and Johnathan Perez, and Justin Horwath, a certified arborist who handles tree risk assessment. Jennifer Schlegel runs the office.
We work for homeowners and for municipalities, county, state, property management and corporate clients. Tree removal is a last resort for us. When a tree has to come down, we have the equipment and skills to do it safely and leave your property looking good. Customers rate us 4.3 from 24 Google reviews.

## Services
- Tree Analysis & Care: We inspect your trees, map the root protection zone and analyze health and needs, then respond with fertilization, disease prevention and healthy pruning as needed.
- Tree Pruning: Pruning removes unproductive branches that use moisture and nutrients, and trims limbs over buildings before high winds bring them down.
- Certified Arborist Consultation: Jordy can inventory and analyze your trees and provide a plan for the long-term development of your treescape.
- Safe Tree Removal: A last resort, done when a tree must come down for safety, the health of nearby vegetation or property management.
- Emergency Tree Care (after Wind or Storm Damage): Help clearing fallen and hanging limbs after a storm, leaving the yard safe and clean.
- Ball Moss Removal and Control
- Air Spade and Root Collar Excavation
- Tree Fertilization

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us or email Jennifer at jennifer@treewisemen.net to set one up.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: San Antonio and surrounding communities, including Boerne, Bulverde, Spring Branch, Kerrville, San Marcos, New Braunfels, South Austin, Seguin, Utopia, Pleasanton and others.

Q: Is there an extra charge outside the city?
A: A mileage charge may apply outside San Antonio city limits.

Q: Do you work on commercial properties?
A: Yes. We serve municipalities, county, state, property management and corporate clients, along with residential customers.

Q: Will you recommend taking my tree down?
A: Only when it's needed. Removal is a last resort, and we look at the tree's health and safety first.
